ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Bookhaus uses the camera to scan a book’s barcode, capture text from a page, or add photos to your notes and diary.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Bookhaus needs access to your photos to change your store’s avatar and banner, or to add pictures to your notes and diary.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Bookhaus uses your approximate location to suggest nearby places when you check in and to sort Book places by distance. Your location is never stored.
